title: Apply the storage lifecycle and resource management migrations to the operating database and deploy the matching release

source.execution_instruction: Owner answer 'Authorize, wait for backup (Recommended)' in this session to the question whether to verify a backup and isolated restore, rehearse on a clone, apply migrations 202611110400, 202611110500 and 202611120100 with goose and a lock timeout, then rebuild and restart the Go API and frontend. A follow-up answer, 'Logical dump + restore check (Recommended)', selected the verified logical dump as the pre-migration backup after admin backup 914858db-6246-4ba1-bbad-709315341765 failed with VERIFICATION_FAILED.

authorizes: a logical dump of the operating database with an isolated restore and preservation-hash comparison
rehearsing the pending migrations on that restored copy

migrations 202611110400_storage_lifecycle, 202611110500_competition_noop_updates and 202611120100_storage_resource_management on the operating database, with sync writers left running and a lock timeout
rebuilding the Go API and the Next.js frontend at the release revision and restarting both
requires: green CI for the release revision
unchanged preservation hashes on the restored copy and on the operating database before and after the migrations
no pending, failed or partially applied migration afterwards
explicitly_not_authorized: deleting, quarantining or purging any existing database, worktree, dump or file
retiring or correcting any recovery-gap registration
reconciling StatsBomb history into the operating database
enabling a storage policy or automatic cleanup
